title: Vacancy circular for Jr. Pharmacovigilance Associate vacant posts purely on contract basis at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC)
bodyHtml:
INDIAN PHARMACOPOEIA COMMISSION
(Ministry of Health & Family Welfare)
Government of India
Sector- 23, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad
Applications are invited for the following vacant posts purely on contract basis at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), an Autonomous organization under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Ghaziabad, through Manpower Resource Outsourcing Services Providing Agency.
Details of Manpower Requirement
S. No. Details of the Positions Salary No.
of Posts		 Place of Posting Qualification Job Description
1 Name of the Post:

Jr. Pharmacovigilance Associate

Age: Not exceeding 28 years		 Rs.26,250/- 25
1. Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), Ghaziabad.

2.The posting as per the requirement of PvPI may be anywhere (AMC/Regional training Centre of PvPI)in India
across the country. (List of AMC available at www.ipc.gov.in)		 Essential Qualification:Master degree in Pharmacy, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy Practice, and Clinical Research.

OR

Pharm. D/ MBBS/BDS from a recognised university/Institute

Desirable: One year experience in drug safety/
Pharmacovigilance 		1. Processing of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) and managing them in VigiFlow.
2. Quality review, Clinical Review & Statistical review of ICSRs in Safety database.
3. Any other work assigned by Competent Authority from time to time.
Period of engagement:
The tenure of contract will be upto 30th November 2022 through GeM, however the contract may be renewed further based on the performance of the applicant. In case the work and conduct of the applicant is not found to be satisfactory during the contract tenure, the services may be terminated at any time without assigning any reason thereof.
General Instructions:

The competent authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies and reject/select/cancellation of all applications received without assigning any reason.

1. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. It is not obligatory on the part of IPC or Manpower Outsourcing Service Agency to call for interview every candidate who possesses the essential qualification. Preference may be given to the candidates who have desirable experience.
2. Experience/Age may be relaxed at discretion of the Competent Authority
3. Interested candidates should submit their application online through Google Form with the following link
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfQ3N7Q1H1dvw_MtzBONfHaUy0QSf2ZEhtEbg0JjjXXgPGnug/viewform (opens in a new tab)
No other mode of submission of application form will be accepted. The last date for submitting the application form is 24.06.2022 closing hours 5.30 pm
